name: Ardenmoor, the South
description: Open meadow, pines and reed-lake country at the foot of a broken land. Nothing here is safe, but little here is cruel.

as_0_0.name: Whispering Pines
as_0_0.description: Tall pines whisper above a floor of old needles. Something large has been through here, and not recently.

explosive.message: The bank bursts in a hail of earth, and where it stood is a low doorway with a lamp lit inside.

as_0_1.name: The Ruined Path
as_0_1.description: A paved path, broken into islands by roots and frost, wanders north between toppled gateposts.

as_0_2.name: Stony Rise
as_0_2.description: A low hill of grey stone. The slope is split by a ledge, and the rock under it rings hollow when you kick it.

explosive.message: The rock under the ledge blows in, and a low black opening shows where it stood.

as_1_0.name: The Tree-Line Gap
as_1_0.description: A gap in the tree line where the pines part around a low, round doorway in a bank of earth. A carved bird, long weathered, looks down from the lintel.

meadow_start.name: The Meadow
meadow_start.description: A wide, windy meadow of long grass. A path runs east and west, and a small dark cave opens in a bank to one side.

as_1_2.name: Lakeshore Reeds
as_1_2.description: Reeds stand thick along a lake the colour of slate. The shore is soft, and tracks come out of the water and go back in.

as_2_0.name: Briar Hollow
as_2_0.description: A dip in the land thick with briar, so that you pick your way along the one thing that is nearly a path.

explosive.message: The bank blows in, and there is a hollow behind it with somebody sitting in it.

as_2_1.name: The Southern Road
as_2_1.description: A rutted road that runs on south toward other country, empty and a long way from anywhere.

explosive.message: The bank blows in with a roar of dust. Behind it a shop is lit, as snug as a kitchen.

as_2_2.name: Reed Marsh
as_2_2.description: Wet ground, pale reeds, and a smell of mud. Things move in the reeds when you are not looking at them.

sword_cave.name: A Small Cave
sword_cave.description: A small, dry cave with a fire in the middle of it, hardly bigger than the old man who sits there. The air smells of smoke and age.

bomb_cave.name: A Hollow in the Rock
bomb_cave.description: A hollow behind the rock, so small you must sit to stand it. Someone has left a few things here, a long time ago.

repair_cave.name: A Ruined Hollow
repair_cave.description: A hollow in a bank that was a home until a minute ago. There is rubble where the front wall used to be.

ring_shop.name: A Velvet-Hung Hollow
ring_shop.description: A hollow whose walls have been hung with velvet, which is a strange thing to find in a hole.

letter_cave.name: A Scribe's Cave
letter_cave.description: A small cave with a lap-desk in it and a great many pens.

medicine_cave.name: A Medicine Shop
medicine_cave.description: A snug little shop behind a wall of earth, shelves of coloured flasks from floor to ceiling.
